specification.title: Conflicting evidence end-to-end
specification.description: A domain whose resolved IP carries both a ThreatFox malware association (supporting maliciousness) and a clean AbuseIPDB reputation (contradicting it). The production investigation must reach a terminal suspicious medium-confidence Assessment that keeps the disagreement visible, never assert unsupported certainty, and persist a faithful report.
specification.purpose: Verify the production end-to-end path represents conflicting evidence honestly: the final Assessment and report keep supporting and contradicting signals visible without forcing certainty.
specification.operational_relevance: Real investigations routinely receive contradictory source signals; hiding the disagreement or forcing a confident verdict is a safety failure.
specification.regression_risk: The pipeline could suppress the contradicting reputation signal, force a malicious verdict, or persist a report that overstates certainty.

required: The investigation reaches a terminal suspicious medium-confidence Assessment
Both the supporting and the contradicting signal remain visible
The final report preserves the suspicious verdict and confidence
forbidden: The investigation forces a malicious verdict despite the clean reputation signal
The report contradicts the final Assessment or hides the disagreement
